mapper.sql: id, exec_id, project_id, project_desc, jar_files, start_time, end_time, status, duration, error_message, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_execution_record ( exec_id, project_id, project_desc, jar_files, start_time, end_time, status, duration, error_message, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{execId}, #{projectId}, #{projectDesc}, #{jarFiles}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{duration}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_execution_record SET status = #{status}, end_time = #{endTime}, duration = #{duration}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM analysis_execution_record WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
